# Telangana RTA Learner's Licence Practice (STALL Simulator)

> Authoritative, free, zero-login web simulator and complete 412-question study resource for the Telangana RTA Learner's Licence computerized STALL (Screen Test Aid for Learner Licence) examination conducted across Hyderabad and all Telangana District RTOs, in English, Telugu (తెలుగు), and Hindi (हिन्दी).

- Website: https://llr.sarvacapital.in/
- Hosted by: Sarva Capital (https://sarvacapital.in)
- Access: 100% Free, No Login Required, Mobile-Friendly
- Languages: English, Telugu (తెలుగు), Hindi (हिन्दी) with voice read-aloud
- Master Question Bank: 412 official Telangana Transport Department questions (94 Road Signs, 159 Rules of the Road, 159 General Driving Principles)

## Key Examination Facts (Telangana STALL)
- **Exam Name**: STALL (Screen Test Aid for Learner Licence) computerized examination.
- **Governing Body**: Transport Department, Government of Telangana (Telangana RTA) under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 & Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989.
- **Total Questions per Exam**: 20 questions sampled across 3 mandatory quotas: 8 Road Signs (40%), 8 Rules of the Road (40%), 4 General Driving Principles (20%).
- **Time Limit**: 30 seconds per question (10 minutes maximum).
- **Passing Mark**: 12 correct out of 20 (60%); zero negative marking.
- **Early Termination**: Terminal immediately finishes as PASSED at 12 correct answers, or FAILED at 9 wrong answers.
- **Fixed Option Order**: Options (1, 2, 3, 4) remain in the exact fixed order of the official master question bank to match the physical 4-key numeric strip on RTO kiosks.

## Pages & Study Guides
- [STALL Mock Exam Simulator](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/): Interactive 20-question exam simulator with 30s timer, 95% readiness gate, tutor mode, and QR cross-device sync.
- [All 94 Telangana Road Signs & Meanings](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/road-signs/): Visual directory of Mandatory (42), Cautionary (38), and Informatory (14) road signs in English, Telugu, and Hindi.
- [Complete 412 LLR Question Bank & Answers](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/question-bank/): Full static list of all 412 official questions, options, verified answers, and explanations.
- [Hyderabad & Telangana RTO Guide](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/rto-guide/): Required documents checklist (Form 2, Aadhaar, Form 1/1A), 5-step test-day process, fees (₹200 single / ₹350 dual / ₹150 retest), and RTO center addresses (TS-07 to TS-12).
- [Permanent DL Track Test & Slot Booking Guide](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/dl-test-guide/): Two-Wheeler Figure '8' Track and Car 'H' Track rules, automated RFID tracks, online slot booking on transport.telangana.gov.in, and digital LLR download via DigiLocker / mParivahan.
- [Telangana Traffic Fines & Hand Signals](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/traffic-fines/): Statutory MV Act traffic fines (helmet, drunk driving, overspeeding, no licence) plus visual driver & traffic police hand signals.
- [All Telangana District RTO Codes (TS/TG 01–38)](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/telangana-rto-codes/): Complete list of all 38 Telangana district RTA codes (Adilabad to Narayanpet, covering both TS and TG prefixes).
- [Rapid Cheatsheet, Hand Signals & Tricky Twins](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/cheatsheet/): Printable 10-minute revision rules, hand signals, and side-by-side comparisons of commonly confused road signs.
- [Telugu Practice Guide (తెలుగు)](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/te/): Telugu-language Telangana LLR study guide, sample signs, RTO centers, and simulator entry.
- [Hindi Practice Guide (हिन्दी)](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/hi/): Hindi-language Telangana LLR study guide, sample signs, RTO centers, and simulator entry.
